name: @margoengine/weather
description: Weather over time: a state machine with presets that blends rain, snow, hail, wind and lightning; a deterministic wind field; wet and snowy surface hooks in JavaScript and WGSL; snow avalanches with a powder cloud that run out, entrain the cover, break trees and settle; volcanic eruption columns with an umbrella cloud, ash fall and plume lightning; lava flows that run down the ground and crust over with glowing cracks, fountains, bombs and glow lights; snow that drifts, builds cornices, sloughs and carries a slab's slide state; helpers for the sky's Weather; and bouncing GPU hail.
author: Scott Campbell

scripts.test:gpu: cd ../.. && node packages/weather/tests/browser-check.mjs && node packages/weather/tests/seek-check.mjs && node packages/weather/tests/settings-check.mjs
scripts.test:browser:parity: cd ../.. && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs gltf && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs gltf --compat && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs cover && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs cover --compat && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs lens && node packages/weather/tests/parity-browser.mjs lens --compat
